behavior.handler: fn(Request) -> Response throws Error; synchronous; an escaping BadRequest (Request.json) answers 400, any other escaping Error 500
behavior.matching: registration order wins; exact segments or one {name} per segment; encoded slashes stay inside a parameter; trailing slash is significant
behavior.query: decoded once by the server, before routing, into Request.query_values (malformed: 400); first value wins; null absent; empty distinct; plus-as-space; query(name) is a lookup that cannot fail
behavior.request: read-only method, decoded path and UTF-8 body; path_param/query/header return String?
behavior.response: Response(status, body, content_type, headers); status 200..599; transport owns framing
behavior.cors: explicit cors_origin adds allow-origin, GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/OPTIONS, Content-Type and Vary headers; OPTIONS 204; no credentials
behavior.openapi: OpenAPI 3.0.3 at /openapi.json; explicit schema metadata only; no body validation
behavior.schema: SchemaType STRING/INTEGER/BOOLEAN/OBJECT/ARRAY; ARRAY requires items; OBJECT uses fields; FieldSchema.required defaults true

host.bind: 127.0.0.1 with run(port); run_on(host, port) binds another address such as 0.0.0.0

metadata_validation: unique query parameter names per operation
equivalent templated paths use identical parameter names across methods
